name: flash-unit
description: A camera flash with a broad Fresnel head, upright body and hot-shoe foot.
useCase: Identify detachable camera flashes in photography equipment.
misuse: Use lightning for an electricity or weather symbol.

24.reason: Three open head sections sit above the full battery body and a narrow solid hot-shoe foot.
